title: Weight of a restriction assignment
statement: For a real parameter $\delta$ and an assignment of one of the states free, fixed at $1$, or fixed at $-1$ to each of the $n$ coordinates, define its weight to be the product over all coordinates of the corresponding coordinate restriction weights at $\delta$.
hypotheses_covered: A restriction state assigned to each of the $n$ coordinates
caveat: The definition of the individual coordinate restriction weight is not included, so its precise dependence on the state and $\delta$ cannot be stated.
